summary.name: Sublime Merge
summary.one_liner: A cross-platform Git client from the makers of Sublime Text, for viewing history, staging changes and browsing commits.
use_cases: stage individual lines or hunks before committing
switch between command line git and a GUI
customise a git client layout and theme
summary.what_it_does: Sublime Merge is a Git client built on a cross-platform GUI toolkit and a custom Git reading library. It lets you stage changes line by line or by hunk, and select lines to split hunks into separate changes. Diffs use the Sublime Text syntax highlighting engine, with over 40 languages supported out of the box and installed third-party syntaxes loaded automatically. It shows the exact Git commands it runs, and offers find-as-you-type commit search. The layout and appearance can be adjusted with a theming system.
notable: Line-by-line and hunk staging with hunk splitting
Sublime Text syntax highlighting in diffs, 40+ languages
Shows the underlying Git commands and works alongside the command line
Find-as-you-type commit search and adaptable theming
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Page does not describe licensing or a free tier
